backdrops.name: Hanami
backdrops.about: Blossom viewing: petals fall past a cherry branch across the moon.

backdrops.name: Rainlight
backdrops.about: A city after rain: drizzle over a skyline of lit windows, magenta beside cyan.

backdrops.name: Evergreen
backdrops.about: A winter wood: snow falling over cut-glass pines.

backdrops.name: Tidewater
backdrops.about: Under the surface: shafts of light swaying through the water, bubbles rising.

backdrops.name: Atoll
backdrops.about: A reef in clear water: a shoal that turns together over swaying kelp.

backdrops.name: Laserdisc
backdrops.about: A synth horizon: a grid running towards you from a striped sun.

backdrops.name: Basalt
backdrops.about: A volcano at night: lava down its flank, embers rising.

backdrops.name: Ukiyo
backdrops.about: A woodblock print: a great wave swelling in Prussian blue, a red sun over cream paper.

backdrops.name: Lanternlight
backdrops.about: A festival evening: paper lanterns swaying on a branch, their light breathing.

backdrops.name: Deepfield
backdrops.about: A long exposure: gas clouds drifting across a dense starfield.

backdrops.name: Midsummer
backdrops.about: The longest evening: a low sun over swaying meadow grass, and fireflies once it is dark.

backdrops.name: Gilded
backdrops.about: An Art Deco foyer: a sunburst in fine gold line, light running across its rays.

backdrops.name: Yuletide
backdrops.about: Midwinter: snow falling, and a string of fairy lights that glow in turn. Berry red on dark fir.

backdrops.name: Hallows
backdrops.about: All Hallows: bats wheeling past an orange moon, a web in the corner.

backdrops.name: Countdown
backdrops.about: New Year's Eve: fireworks opening one after another over a field of stars. Gold on midnight.

backdrops.name: Lunar
backdrops.about: Lunar New Year: red lanterns swaying, gold sparks rising.

backdrops.name: Valentine
backdrops.about: Hearts rising slowly, like bubbles. Peony pink on white.

backdrops.name: Diwali
backdrops.about: The festival of lights: a row of oil lamps along the foot, flames alive, sparks rising.

backdrops.name: Harvest
backdrops.about: Autumn: leaves coming down, turning as they fall, on warm paper.

backdrops.name: Pixel Overworld
backdrops.about: Daylight in eight bits: clouds drifting over stepped hills, three hearts over a new thread. After dark, a crescent and square stars.

backdrops.name: Pixel Dungeon
backdrops.about: Torchlight on stone: brickwork fading down the wall, a torch burning in each corner, a key over a new thread.

backdrops.name: Pixel Cosmos
backdrops.about: Deep space: a ringed planet among square stars, and a saucer that hangs about.

backdrops.name: Pixel Pocket
backdrops.about: A pocket console: the dot matrix showing through, and a small creature that hops and blinks.

backdrops.name: Pixel Campfire
backdrops.about: A fire in the pines: flames flickering, embers going up, stars out.

backdrops.name: Pixel Reef
backdrops.about: Square fish gliding past, weed swaying, bubbles going up.

backdrops.name: Orrery
backdrops.about: A model solar system: four planets on their rings round a sun, each keeping its own year, one with a moon.

backdrops.name: Automata
backdrops.about: Conway's Game of Life: two gliders crossing the chat a generation at a time, a blinker keeping time.

backdrops.name: Circuit
backdrops.about: A circuit board: traces fanning out from a chip to their vias, signals running home along them.

backdrops.name: Cascade
backdrops.about: Columns of hex falling down a green screen, their tails fading.

backdrops.name: Hilbert
backdrops.about: A space-filling curve, and two points of light working their way along all 1,023 of its turns.

backdrops.name: Harmonic
backdrops.about: A pendulum wave: eleven pendulums, each a little quicker than the last, falling in and out of step every ninety seconds.

backdrops.name: Insomnia
backdrops.about: The original: violet dusk over blue-black.

backdrops.name: Insomnia Dune
backdrops.about: Warm stars over a desert horizon, dusty rose; a sun over the dunes by day.

backdrops.name: Insomnia Ember
backdrops.about: A campfire night: warm stars and an ember-orange glow.

backdrops.name: Insomnia Graphite
backdrops.about: No colour at all: starlight on graphite.

backdrops.name: Nocturne
backdrops.about: Cyan and periwinkle curtains over midnight blue.

backdrops.name: Obsidian
backdrops.about: Sage-green light on black glass.

backdrops.name: Carbon
backdrops.about: Black, white, and nothing else.

backdrops.name: Vellum
backdrops.about: Sepia ink on cream paper.

backdrops.name: Porcelain
backdrops.about: Cobalt on white, the classic.

backdrops.name: Classic

backdrops.name: Luminous
